items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I especially think of Wigpen, you know, and Pha Terrell was singin'.

ctx.x: And the drummer knew how to come down. I especially think of Wigpen, you know, and Pha Terrell was singin'.

What I was really trying to figure was what you said about the drums. Now I can see where if the drums are not gonna' play any louder than the bass, you know, in proportion to that, now what sort--the sound that carried out in the hall to the people--let's say the hall is crowded and everything==the banjo used to cut some, didn't it?
